interpretation_rules: Industry benchmark results are comparators, not Symthaea measurements.
Targets are proposals until a protocol-matched experiment measures them.
A synthetic-fixture result is not a broad benchmark score.
No score is eligible unless task admission and independent evidence requirements pass.

Legacy-Bench publications/views may report different aggregation metrics. Factory's official methodology page reports overall pass rate; the Fireworks index reports avg@3. Keep them separate and do not compare the percentages as if they share a protocol.

legacy_bench.comparability_note: Legacy-Bench uses its own task distribution and harness. Compare only using authorized full-benchmark access and a matched protocol; avg@3 is not pass@1. This Fireworks-index avg@3 view is separate from Factory's official Legacy-Bench page, which currently displays an overall pass-rate leaderboard updated April 2026; do not conflate the 62% avg@3 listing with the 42.5% official-page score.

swe_bench_pro_v2.comparability_note: Different benchmark and protocol; never compare its raw percentage directly with Legacy-Bench or VLEB.

agent_security_league.comparability_note: Vendor benchmark results are contextual evidence for separating functional correctness from security correctness, not direct VLEB comparisons.

dual_gauge.claim: The paper reports the strongest evaluated model below 15% joint functional-and-security success in each tested language.
dual_gauge.comparability_note: Specification-only code-generation benchmark with paired functional/security tests; not directly comparable with Legacy-Bench or VLEB.

last_secure_code_benchmark.comparability_note: Preprint benchmark across its own task and agent setup; use as motivation for joint security/functionality measurement, not as a direct VLEB score.

legacy_code_bench_2026.method: Claim-based generated documentation checked against execution of original programs
legacy_code_bench_2026.comparability_note: Not a VLEB measurement or direct score comparator; different source corpus, model set, harness and scoring policy. Borrow source-anchored behavioral-claim methodology.

ibm_enterprise_cobol_to_java_icse_2026.comparability_note: Different dataset and scoring rubric; not directly comparable to hidden-test resolution. Borrow hybrid static-analysis and metadata-first pipeline design.

swe_bench_leaderboard_stability_audit.comparability_note: An observational audit of existing submissions; does not establish equivalence or causal scaffold effects. Motivates paired tests, uncertainty reporting and model-scaffold provenance.

methodology.task_description: Hundreds of tasks with containerized source environments, reference solutions and hidden verification tests

legacy_bench_official_factory.comparability_note: Different published view and aggregation from the Fireworks index's avg@3 listing. Page states last updated April 2026. Do not compare 42.5% overall pass rate directly against 62% avg@3 or use either as a VLEB result.

scored_task_admission_pct.definition: Every task in a headline cohort has independently reviewed behavior requirements, empty/baseline failure, reference success and locked evidence.

reviewed_non_equivalent_compilable_mutan.definition: Killed mutants / reviewed, non-equivalent, compilable mutants; report separately by mutation family.

cost_per_verified_fix_reduction_pct.definition: Reduction against a matched baseline with a preregistered correctness non-inferiority margin.

legacy_bench_cost_frontier.definition: Reach at least 60% avg@3 at no more than $0.25 per task on the full authorized Legacy-Bench under a matched protocol.
legacy_bench_cost_frontier.rationale: Targets a lower-cost quality frontier relative to the October 22 listing's 62% at $0.49/task leader; this is a research hypothesis, not an achieved outcome.
requirements: report p50/p90 duration and unresolved rate

secure_legacy_admission.target: 100% of scored secure-legacy tasks have paired functional and security oracles independently reviewed
secure_legacy_admission.definition: Every scored task must have separately identified functional and security tests, a reviewed exploitability/severity rubric, false-positive adjudication, and controls showing both positive and negative cases.
requirements: preregister critical/high escape-rate threshold before confirmation
report joint success separately from functional success

cobol_source_index_precision_recall_pct.admission_rule: Measure on independently annotated authorized/synthetic corpus; report precision, recall and diagnostic recall by anchor family. This is not a full parser or modernization target.

source_claim_false_support_rate_pct.definition: Percentage of claims labeled supported when their locked independent witness contradicts the claim or is inconclusive. Count only after witness artifacts and verifier identities are checked against out-of-band pins.

legacy_bench_avg_at_3_pct.reason: No authorized full Legacy-Bench evaluation of Symthaea has been run.

vleb_scored_tasks.reason: The ledger task is public-development-only and has no independent task-admission review.

active_synthetic_mutation_smoke_test.interpretation: Initial oracle-smoke test only; 4/4 must not be represented as the broad VLEB mutation target being achieved.

security_correctness_pct.reason: No independently reviewed secure-legacy cohort has been evaluated.

cost_per_independently_verified_fix_usd.reason: No matched baseline versus Symthaea confirmatory trial has been run.

security_joint_functional_success_pct.reason: No independently reviewed secure-legacy cohort has been evaluated.

source_claim_false_support_rate_pct.reason: The atomic claim schema and negative controls exist, but no independently adjudicated claim corpus or trusted witness auditor has been evaluated.

assurance_adjusted_semantic_success_rate.formula: independently_verified_passes / all tasks assigned to the locked confirmatory cohort
pass_requirements: every declared observable has passing differential evidence
task-level mutation gate meets its preregistered criterion
evidence hashes, checkout, runtime and toolchain identities validate
trusted manifest, attestation and independent receipt audit pass
denominator_rules: freeze task admission before arm assignment and score inspection
failed, unresolved and abstained outcomes remain non-passes in the denominator
show unresolved, failure and abstention rates separately
allow exclusions only for predeclared reasons adjudicated blind to arm
companion_metrics: raw candidate-resolution rate before assurance checks

cost_per_independently_verified_fix.formula: total model + tool + compute + retry + human-intervention cost / independently verified passes
cost_per_independently_verified_fix.zero_pass_rule: report denominator as zero and metric as undefined; never report zero cost
cost_per_independently_verified_fix.comparability: only compare matched task cohort, model/scaffold/tool budgets, tool permissions and infrastructure pricing

avg_at_3.note: Must use three attempts and the benchmark's exact aggregation rules; never relabel as pass@1.

claim_scopes.textual_anchor: Proves only that a source anchor such as a PROGRAM-ID, COPY reference or PIC text exists at an exact source span.
claim_scopes.static_structure: Requires a pinned static analyzer/parser witness and preserves unresolved/unsupported states.
claim_scopes.runtime_behavior: Requires an independently executed behavioral witness; text or static indexing alone cannot establish numeric, transaction or business-rule behavior.

scored_claim_requirements: source-file digest matches bytes under the evidence root
every source span excerpt hash is recomputed
witness artifact digest matches bytes in the sealed evidence bundle
verifier implementation digest matches an out-of-band allowlist
verdict agrees with the independent witness result
runtime claims have independent execution witnesses
do_not_score_as_supported: claim whose source span or witness hash mismatches
